name: Jiangsu Dingsheng New Materials Joint-Stock Co.,Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Dingsheng New Materials Joint-Stock Co.,Ltd engages in research and development, production, and sale of aluminum plates, strip, and foils. Its products portfolio includes aluminum and aluminum alloy plates, belts, sheets, and coating materials, as well as processed products comprising aluminum oxide plates, cable foils, air-conditioner foils, decorative building material aluminum foils, air conditioner refrigerator evaporators, condensers, container foils, single and double zero foils, aluminium matrix composite, battery foil, and others.
